brief.vision: Mobile cashless smart laundromat management system

requirements.statement: Customers shall scan a QR code on any machine and pay from their phone
requirements.rationale: Reduces dependency on physical coins and cash

source.excerpt: scan a QR code on any machine, pay from their phone

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer is at a machine
acceptance_criteria.when: They scan the QR code and pay
acceptance_criteria.then: The machine starts running within 5 seconds

requirements.statement: The platform shall provide a dashboard showing real-time machine status
requirements.rationale: Enables operators to monitor machines remotely

source.excerpt: dashboard showing real-time machine status

acceptance_criteria.then: They see real-time status of all washing machines

requirements.statement: The platform API shall respond quickly enough that a machine starts within 5 seconds of payment

source.excerpt: payment confirmation to machine start within five seconds

requirements.statement: IoT controllers shall push status over MQTT every ten seconds

source.excerpt: push status over MQTT every ten seconds

acceptance_criteria.then: It publishes state to MQTT broker every 10 seconds

requirements.statement: Integrate Stripe Connect so each laundromat location is a connected account
requirements.rationale: Automates multi-location financial split and settlement

source.excerpt: integrate Stripe Connect so each laundromat location is a connected account

acceptance_criteria.then: A Stripe connected account is generated

requirements.statement: Provide a Spin Pass monthly subscription option for twenty-five dollars a month for unlimited washes

source.excerpt: twenty-five dollars a month for unlimited standard washes

acceptance_criteria.then: They get unlimited standard washes

requirements.statement: Implement an idle fee of twenty-five cents per minute if door is not opened

source.excerpt: maybe twenty-five cents per minute

acceptance_criteria.then: Accumulate idle fee at $0.25/min

requirements.statement: Customers can join a virtual waitlist and get notified when a machine frees up

source.excerpt: join a virtual waitlist and get notified when one frees up

acceptance_criteria.then: Customer is added to waitlist queue

requirements.statement: Corporate clients can reserve three washers from six to eight AM

source.excerpt: reserve three washers from six to eight AM

acceptance_criteria.then: Selected machines are locked out for general public

requirements.statement: Process refunds directly through Stripe Connect
requirements.rationale: Ensures quick resolution of machine malfunction issues

source.excerpt: refunds need to be handled too

acceptance_criteria.then: Invoke Stripe Connect refund API

requirements.statement: An attendant sees machine status and can flag maintenance

source.excerpt: attendant sees machine status and can flag maintenance

acceptance_criteria.then: Attendant sees statuses but cannot view revenue logs

requirements.statement: Enforce two-factor authentication, probably TOTP-based for dashboards

source.excerpt: two-factor authentication, probably TOTP-based

acceptance_criteria.then: Prompt for TOTP code

requirements.statement: The platform shall meet WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines

source.excerpt: meet WCAG 2.1 AA

requirements.statement: The platform must support English and Spanish at launch

source.excerpt: English and Spanish at launch

requirements.statement: All traffic shall be secured via TLS 1.3

source.excerpt: All traffic TLS 1.3

requirements.statement: PII must be encrypted at rest using AES-256

source.excerpt: PII encrypted at rest — AES-256

requirements.statement: Enforce API rate limiting to a hundred requests per minute per user
requirements.rationale: Prevents API overload and denial of service

source.excerpt: API rate limiting to prevent abuse: a hundred requests per minute

requirements.statement: Transaction data must be kept for seven years for compliance

source.excerpt: Transaction data kept for seven years

requirements.statement: Design the schema to support offline machine start post-launch
requirements.rationale: Prepares architecture for offline fallback support

source.excerpt: offline machine start is a post-launch feature. We'll design the schema to support it

acceptance_criteria.then: Offline capability columns must exist

requirements.statement: The platform API shall support at least five hundred concurrent users without degradation

source.excerpt: verify the API handles at least five hundred concurrent users

user_stories.i_want: to scan a QR code on a machine and pay using my phone
user_stories.so_that: I can start wash cycles cashless without needing coins

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer scans the QR code
acceptance_criteria.when: They select a cycle and pay via Stripe
acceptance_criteria.then: Payment is processed and machine W-07 starts

edge_cases: Incomplete Stripe transaction should abort machine start

user_stories.i_want: to view real-time status of all machines on a live floor map
user_stories.so_that: I can quickly see which machines are idle, running, or faulted

acceptance_criteria.given: An Operations Manager has active location
acceptance_criteria.then: Machine color codes show W-07 running and D-03 idle

edge_cases: Network connectivity loss of a machine shows it as offline
